about: Trees found while researching Chiang Mai that are not published. Source for most: the Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees of the Land lists (2017, 2018, 2019) as reproduced in th.wikipedia.

leads.name: Yang na avenue, Chiang Mai to Lamphun old road (Highway 106)
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees 2017 list, 'Yang Na Raksa Sing Waetlom' group; Thai PBS and Royal Forest Department say about 949 trees; Thai Forest Bulletin study of 1,107 trees; 2026-10-19 Banmuang article describes the avenue still standing
leads.note: Famous avenue about 9 to 15 km long, planted c. 1882 to 1911 (sources disagree), protected since 2019 so only government may cut or trim. Alive in 2026. Not a collectible point: avenue. lifecheck NONE at the register point. A single place to stand (a named tree or shrine along the Saraphi stretch) would make it a tree page; none named yet. Lamphun side has a 116-year khilek (Senna siamea) group, same register.

leads.name: Giant rain tree, Chiang Mai Gymkhana Club
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees 2017 list; TCP Spirit and The Cloud say about 150 years; a 2005 profile says over 100 years, 15 m tall, 13 m girth, crown radius 25.87 m
leads.note: Members club grounds; access for non-members unsettled (the club has a restaurant open to the public, not confirmed). Ages disagree (100 to 150, no ring count). No alive evidence beyond news (lifecheck NONE). Needs access settled and a dated photo.

leads.name: Ma Chamrong tree, San Pa Tong
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees 2017 list; sanpatong.info 2018-01-06 (Culture Minister visited and paid respects at the town's namesake tree next to Ma Chamrong market)
leads.note: Local landmark beside the old market on Highway 108, but about 25 km from the old city (45+ minutes), beyond day-trip band. Register cells corrupt. Species uncertain (the article says 'samrong'). Alive in 2018 only.

leads.name: Fig embracing teak, Dong Phra Chao Nang Kon, Hang Dong
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees 2019 list; TrueID travel page (no body text fetched)
leads.note: No coordinate or figures found. Hang Dong is south of the city. Needs a pin and a source with figures.

leads.name: Wrapped trees, Doi Inthanon (Ang Ka summit forest)
leads.source: Ministry of Culture Heritage Trees 2018 list
leads.note: Cloud forest groups at the summit of Doi Inthanon National Park, about 100 km from the city: label as a day trip by car, group, not a point.
